values.zh-CN: 激活的 Macro Package 引用

content.markdown:
`active_macro_packages` is optional. When present during topology inspection it MUST be an array of strings. Every value MUST be whitespace-canonical, satisfy the Package ID grammar, differ from the reserved `_unpackaged` ID, and resolve to an existing Package manifest.

The current inspector does not require this array to be duplicate-free. The Dashboard normalizer validates the string and Package-ID shape but relies on topology inspection for the reserved-ID and existence checks.
